parameters.question: Compare PCoA coordinates (beta diversity ordination of 16S ASV table) per sample. Coordinates must match the reference within +/-0.05 per axis; each axis may be globally sign-flipped (multiply entire axis by -1) and column order may differ. Rows should be aligned by sample ID.

Compare PERMANOVA results tables from 16S ASV beta diversity analysis. R^2 and F-statistic must match the reference within 5% relative absolute error; Pr(>F) need only agree in significance direction (p < 0.05). Row and column order may differ.

Differential abundance analysis of 16S ASV table between sample groups (DESeq2-style). Align rows by ASV ID; log2FoldChange and padj must match the reference within 1% relative absolute error; row and column order may differ.
